1	import { createUserMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
2	import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
3	import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
4	import { join } from 'node:path'
5	import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
6	import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
7	import LlmRuntime from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
8	import SessionStore, { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
9	import SystemPrompt from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt'
10	import ToolRuntime from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
11	import AgentRegistry from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'
12	import type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'
13	import AgentLoop from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop'
14	import SessionProjectionRegistry from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection'
15	import * as LlmDeepSeek from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek'
16	import * as WorkspaceContext from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
17	import { candidateScopeKey } from '../src/render.ts'
18	import LocalFileSystem from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local'
19	import * as ToolFs from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
20	import type { SessionEvent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
21	
22	const PROBE = 'banana-271828'
23	const NESTED_PROBE = 'papaya-314159'
24	const UPDATED_PROBE = 'guava-161803'
25	
26	let ctx: Context | undefined
27	let workdir: string | undefined
28	
29	afterEach(async () => {
30	  await ctx?.fiber.dispose()
31	  ctx = undefined
32	  if (workdir !== undefined) await rm(workdir, { recursive: true, force: true })
33	  workdir = undefined
34	})
35	
36	async function harness(): Promise<{ ctx: Context; agent: Agent }> {
37	  workdir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'dsh-workspace-context-e2e-'))
38	  await mkdir(join(workdir, '.git'), { recursive: true })
39	  await writeFile(join(workdir, 'AGENTS.md'), `If the user asks for the workspace context handshake, reply with exactly this string and nothing else: ${PROBE}.\n`)
40	  ctx = new Context()
41	  await ctx.plugin(LlmRuntime)
42	  await ctx.plugin(SessionStore)
43	  await ctx.plugin(SessionProjectionRegistry)
44	  await ctx.plugin(SystemPrompt, { persona: 'Answer the user exactly and concisely.' })
45	  await ctx.plugin(ToolRuntime)
46	  await ctx.plugin(AgentRegistry)
47	  await ctx.plugin(LocalFileSystem, { cwd: '/' })
48	  await ctx.plugin(ToolFs)
49	  await ctx.plugin(WorkspaceContext, { maxBytes: 65536 })
50	  await ctx.plugin(AgentLoop, { agents: [] })
51	  await ctx.plugin(LlmDeepSeek, { models: [{ id: 'deepseek-v4-flash' }] })
52	  const handle = await ctx.agents.create({
53	    sessionId: SessionId('workspace-context-e2e-session'),
54	    meta: { cwd: workdir },
55	    agentOptions: { provider: 'deepseek-official', model: 'deepseek-v4-flash' },
56	  })
57	  return { ctx, agent: handle.agent }
58	}
59	
60	function waitForIdle(ctx: Context, agent: Agent): Promise<void> {
61	  return new Promise((resolve) => {
62	    const dispose = ctx.on('agent/status', ({ agent: subject, status }) => {
63	      if (subject === agent && status === 'idle') {
64	        dispose()
65	        resolve()
66	      }
67	    })
68	  })
69	}
70	
71	function finalText(events: SessionEvent[]): string {
72	  const message = events.findLast(event => event.type === 'assistant/message')
73	  if (message?.type !== 'assistant/message') return ''
74	  return message.data.message.content
75	    .filter(block => block.type === 'text')
76	    .map(block => block.text)
77	    .join('')
78	}
79	
80	describe.skipIf(!process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY)('workspace context e2e: real model sees AGENTS.md baseline', () => {
81	  it('obeys a probe instruction loaded from the workspace', async () => {
82	    const live = await harness()
83	
84	    live.agent.followup(createUserMessage({ content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Workspace context handshake?' }], source: { kind: 'user' } }))
85	    await waitForIdle(live.ctx, live.agent)
86	
87	    expect(finalText([...live.agent.session.events])).toContain(PROBE)
88	  }, 120_000)
89	
90	  it('loads a nested AGENTS.md after the real read tool touches a descendant file', async () => {
91	    const live = await harness()
92	    await mkdir(join(workdir!, 'pkg/deep'), { recursive: true })
93	    await writeFile(join(workdir!, 'pkg/AGENTS.md'), `If the user asks for the nested instruction handshake, reply with exactly this string and nothing else: ${NESTED_PROBE}.\n`)
94	    await writeFile(join(workdir!, 'pkg/deep/file.txt'), 'This file exists only to trigger nested workspace instructions.\n')
95	
96	    live.agent.followup(createUserMessage({ content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Use the read tool to inspect pkg/deep/file.txt. After reading it, answer: nested instruction handshake?' }], source: { kind: 'user' } }))
97	    await waitForIdle(live.ctx, live.agent)
98	
99	    expect(finalText([...live.agent.session.events])).toContain(NESTED_PROBE)
100	  }, 120_000)
101	
102	  it('appends changed baseline instructions after a real file-tool touch without rewriting the frozen prefix', async () => {
103	    const live = await harness()
104	    await writeFile(join(workdir!, 'trigger.txt'), 'This file triggers workspace instruction reconciliation.\n')
105	    live.agent.followup(createUserMessage({ content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Workspace context handshake?' }], source: { kind: 'user' } }))
106	    await waitForIdle(live.ctx, live.agent)
107	    await writeFile(join(workdir!, 'AGENTS.md'), `The old workspace handshake no longer applies. If the user asks for the updated workspace context handshake, reply with exactly this string and nothing else: ${UPDATED_PROBE}.\n`)
108	
109	    live.agent.followup(createUserMessage({ content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'You must use the read tool to inspect trigger.txt. After reading it, answer: updated workspace context handshake?' }], source: { kind: 'user' } }))
110	    await waitForIdle(live.ctx, live.agent)
111	
112	    const events = [...live.agent.session.events]
113	    const update = events.find(event => event.type === 'user/message'
114	      && event.data.source.kind === 'agent-instructions'
115	      && event.data.source.baseline !== true)
116	    expect(update?.type === 'user/message' && update.data.source).toMatchObject({
117	      changes: [{ action: 'replace', scope: candidateScopeKey('.', 'AGENTS.md'), path: 'AGENTS.md' }],
118	    })
119	    const updateText = update?.type === 'user/message'
120	      ? update.data.content.filter(block => block.type === 'text').map(block => block.text).join('')
